title: Sage skeleton_sockets record
description: A skeleton_sockets record (SkeletonSocketsRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another skeleton_sockets record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

model.description: The skinned model (.glb) whose skeleton these sockets are on. A mesh path. (AssetPath)

sockets.description: Sockets by name ("hand_r"): what an attachment's `socket` names. (Dictionary<string, SkeletonSocket>)

joint.description: The joint it hangs from, by name as the model writes it. (string)

offset.description: Where it sits in the joint's space. Unit: m. (Vector3)

angles.description: How it is turned in the joint's space: pitch, yaw, roll. Unit: deg. (Vector3)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
